subject: WiFi connectivity drops every 15-20 minutes affecting POS and kitchen displays
description: ServeWell - Kurla is experiencing intermittent WiFi disconnections on the guest and operational networks. The NetLink NL-3000 router (RTR-0010-01) loses connectivity approximately every 15-20 minutes, lasting 30-45 seconds each time. This is severely impacting point-of-sale (POS) operations during peak hours (18:00-22:00), causing transaction delays and customer dissatisfaction. Kitchen display system (KDS) also loses connection intermittently, disrupting order flow. All connected devices (5 POS terminals, 2 KDS units, staff devices) are affected simultaneously, indicating a router-level issue rather than device-specific problem. Error messages observed: 'Network Unreachable' on POS terminals and automatic WiFi reconnection cycles on mobile devices. Issue began 3 days ago (2026-04-12) and is occurring consistently. Store manager reports this is impacting approximately 40-50 orders per evening service. Router firmware version confirmed as NetLink NL-3000 v2.2. No recent configuration changes or power outages reported. Basic troubleshooting attempted: router restart (temporary 2-hour relief), power cycle of all client devices, and verification of DHCP settings.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Remote diagnostics scheduled for 2026-04-16 morning. Customer advised to document disconnect times and reboot router if drops exceed 5 minutes during business hours.

Requested router access logs and WiFi signal strength reports from store. Preliminary assessment suggests possible interference or thermal throttling; escalation to L2 Network Engineering pending log review.
